recipe.description: PlayerBody original face direction: broad oval cranial mass, restrained square jaw turn and projecting chin, high cheek planes, moderate bridge, and substantial neck. Stable seeded colors remain independent. Source parameter labels do not establish biography, ethnicity, age or gender identity. Fixed Player presentation; no personal name.

source_indices: All source vertex/UV/face/triangle indices are zero based. Face IDs count every OBJ f line. Triangle IDs count every original face fan triangle, including discarded body regions and helper groups.
lod: Original retained face topology is shared. No simplification or detail-destroying decimation is applied.

head_rig_membership.rule: Union of external_head, mouth_interior and both socket source chart triangle vertices, including every seam alias; exactly Head. Neck interior blends from source neck landmark to nearest angular head/neck source seam.
